main.description: One half of a Consensual Claims System pair. In force only while both halves exist and cross-reference; either side severs unilaterally by deleting its half. See docs/acp.md §Mutual claims and docs/ccs.md.

relationship.description: Relationship kind from the published catalog. Advisory (knownValues): unknown kinds must validate and be ignored. Kinds form defined pairs (owns/ownedBy, memberOf/hasMember).

counterpart.description: The other party. Their repo must hold the answering half for the relationship to be in force.

counterpartRecord.description: Optional expected uri of the other half, once known.

scope.description: Relationship-defined content THIS side is authoritative for (authority partitioning: verifiers ignore scope fields a side is not authoritative for).
